# Skeleton

> Loading placeholders with seamless shimmer, pulse, and static variants. Match their dimensions to the incoming content.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `skeleton` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/skeleton.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/skeleton.md`.

## Registry dependencies

- `core`
- `effects`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/skeleton-knobs`: `skeletonKnobs`, types `SkeletonKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/skeleton`: `skeletonVariants`, `skeletonShapes`, `Skeleton`, types `SkeletonVariant`, `SkeletonShape`, `SkeletonProps`

## Composition

### Loading placeholder

```tsx
<Skeleton />
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/card";
import { Skeleton, skeletonVariants } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/skeleton";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

const variantLabels = { shimmer: "Shimmer", pulse: "Pulse", none: "Static" };

export function PrimitiveSkeletonExample() {
  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        {skeletonVariants.map((variant) => (
          <div key={variant} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <Text size="label" weight="medium" tone="muted">
              {variantLabels[variant]}
            </Text>
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <Skeleton variant={variant} shape="circle" className="size-10 shrink-0" />
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-2 py-1">
                <Skeleton variant={variant} className="h-3 w-2/3" />
                <Skeleton variant={variant} className="h-3 w-full" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `skeleton`
  - `root`: `data-shape` (`circle` | `default` | `panel`), `data-variant` (`none` | `pulse` | `shimmer`)

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### skeleton

- `--cui-skeleton-radius`: `var(--radius-control)`
- `--cui-skeleton-background`: `var(--muted)`
- `--cui-skeleton-background-image`: `none`
- `--cui-skeleton-highlight-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.06)`
- `--cui-skeleton-animation-duration`: `calc(var(--duration-slow) * 5)`
- `--cui-skeleton-easing`: `var(--ease-standard)`
- `--cui-skeleton-pulse-opacity`: `0.5`
